inspiration: Loading screen as three stacked layers: a full-bleed backdrop, one small emblem low in the centre, and one small corner caption (public/Wowser/WowserFrame.xml lines 7-39). It reads as alive while data loads.
In this donor the corner caption is a version string. Ours can use the same corner slot for a rotating tip plus a progress bar.
Layout as a declarative XML tree with anchors and absolute sizes (WowserFrame.xml lines 3-16). Makes the 375-wide HUD layout data rather than code.
Lua vendored for UI scripting (src/ui/scripting/vendor) with XML layout gives a data-first UI: layout as a tree, behaviour as script. Relevant to hud-ui; only the vendor headers were read.
No creature, item, armour, zone or effect content is in this donor, so there are no creature or armour ideas to take from it.

briefs.label: Quiet loading screen stack
briefs.why: Calm and readable at 375 wide; a low centred emblem and a corner caption tell the player the game is alive while data loads. Silhouette and sound: none in the box.
keep: three stacked layers: backdrop, emblem, caption
emblem centred near the bottom edge and not competing with the scene
caption kept small in one corner
change: original backdrop painted in our palette, never a copied loading image
our own emblem in place of the donor's emblem slot
caption carries a rotating tip with a progress bar instead of a version string; recreate from scratch as an original
